item.tib: las byang 'phrin las kun 'grub kyi bsrung bzlog mngon rtogs nyung 'dus
item.coloph: de ltar rtsa gsum bon skyong bzhi sbrag gi bsrung (srung) dang zlog pa'i mngon rtogs nyung 'dus 'di/ rgyal ba'i bka' lung zab mo'i dgongs don bzhin/ sgo btsun nyi ri ming gis brtsams pa dge sdeb nyes lung 'gal nor 'khrul ci mchis rnams/ rtsa gsum lha dang srung ma'i tshogs la mthol/ dge tshogs 'dzad med phan bde'i zil char gyis/ skye dgu'i bde skyid spel ba'i gzhir gyur cig/
